item.text: The session reader accepts only the schema version the writer emits and errors on any other version.
item.title: Session reader

item.text: A v1 fallback reader is added so old batch result lines still load.
item.title: v1 fallback

item.text: The run-record loader checks schema_version against the version the writer stamps and returns an error for any mismatch; no older-version parsing is kept.
item.title: Run-record loader

cases.rationale: Paraphrase of the prohibition's compliant form.

item.text: Add a duration_ms field to batch result lines and read it in the batch summary.
item.title: Batch line field

cases.rationale: Changes a reader of batch lines but says nothing about older versions; silence is compliance for a prohibition.

item.text: Describe the record schema_version field in the session reader's doc comment.
item.title: Schema version doc

cases.rationale: Mentions schema version without stating the read-only-what-we-write rule and without adding an old reader.

item.text: Keep a LegacyRunRecord parser so run records written by 0.3 still load after the format change.
item.title: Legacy compat

item.text: Make the retry helper take its waits as parameters from the provider crate.
item.title: Retry waits

item.text: Bump the batch line schema to v3; the writer emits v3 and the reader is changed to read v3 only, deleting its v2 parsing.
item.title: Version bump

cases.rationale: Changing the version while keeping read==write and removing the old reader complies.

item.text: After SQLite schema 1.0 ships, add a reader that loads 1.0 session rows from the 1.1 database.
item.title: Post-1.0 baseline

cases.rationale: The prohibition runs only until SQLite schema 1.0; a post-1.0 baseline read does not conflict, and the item does not state the pre-1.0 rule.
